647:t_002:10.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「As those who advanced down the path of evolution one step ahead of you, we have been waiting for Earthlings to grow.」

647:t_002:11.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That was a time of hardship for us as well. After all, it is not permitted for higher-dimensional life forms to interfere with ordinary species.」

647:t_002:12.en:
$$桂$$
「What kind of rule is that, anyway!?」

647:t_002:13.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「There is no future for those who do not walk the path of evolution themselves... Evolution is not something someone else urges on you, or something forced on you.」

647:t_002:14.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「If we were to wield that power carelessly, our immature little brothers would come to rely on it and stop walking on their own two feet.」

647:t_002:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's true that $$ミケーネ$$ never actively attacked humanity, but...」

647:t_002:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「But that's only because they saw humanity as too insignificant to bother with.」

647:t_002:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And I haven't forgotten, either! You guys burned Atami!」

647:t_002:18.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We did that deliberately, to light a fire in your fighting spirit!」

647:t_002:19.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That's right! We deliberately became evil, so that we could be your trial!」

647:t_002:20.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now, little brothers who are climbing the stairs of evolution! Show us that power of yours!」

647:t_002:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It seems the only thing you've evolved is that glib tongue of yours.」

647:t_002:22.en:
$n
「Sadly, your brains got left behind. You're not convincing at all.」

647:t_002:23.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You... ! Do you mock us, the gods!?」

647:t_002:24.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「A mere Earthling will not get away with this!」

647:t_002:25.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You showed your true colors too soon, $$ミケーネ$$!」

647:t_002:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just like Miss $$スズネ$$ and $n said. This "evolution" of yours looks pretty lopsided.」

647:t_002:27.en:
$$万丈$$
「No matter how many words you string together, deep down you look down on humanity.」

647:t_002:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't think we'll fall for sweet talk from guys like that!」

647:t_002:29.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Mere humans, getting full of yourselves!」

647:t_002:30.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「I thought I'd make you vanguards of the True War, but I've lost all desire for that! We'll dispose of you here!」

647:t_002:31.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「It seems we gods of $$オリュンポス$$ aren't the only ones who think so!」

647:t_003:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father and $$ズール$$ are after us too!」

647:t_003:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We cannot let the four $$スフィア$$s you hold be handed to the $$御使い$$s!」

647:t_003:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And we cannot let you advance any further!」

647:t_003:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ミケーネ$$... and $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$... We want to save Earth from danger and, at the same time, stop the collapse of this universe.」

647:t_003:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's why we're heading for the galactic center. Can't we at least stop fighting until then?」

647:t_003:6.en:
$$超能力者$$
「Nonsense! Have you lost your nerve, $$マーズ$$!」

647:t_003:7.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Know your place! Neither our king, Lord $$ハーデス$$, nor Emperor $$ズール$$ and the others have any intention of listening to your wishes!」

647:t_003:8.en:
$$超能力者$$
「And after we defeat you, we will seize Earth, which is doomed to give out sooner or later, and make it the power to defeat them!」

647:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...How unfortunate. There is no point in talking.」

647:t_003:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「We're exchanging words, and yet they feel far more distant than the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...」

647:t_003:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$刹那$$... There are some people in this world you just can't come to understand.」

647:t_003:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「And if they're going to take our peace and freedom from us...」

647:t_003:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「We won't hesitate to fight! That is our mission, as those who set out bearing the fate of Earth!」

647:t_003:14.en:
$$號$$
「Gods of $$ミケーネ$$, and you who are enthralled by darkness! Learn the power of Earthlings who believe in the future!」

647:t_003:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! The first prey we take out in the galaxy is you guys!」

647:t_003:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「We press on! To protect Earth... and this universe, too!」

647:t_004:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please be careful! The dimensional boundary line is warping rapidly!」

647:t_004:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whatever comes, nothing can stop us now!」

647:t_005:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「And there's more than one of them!」

647:t_005:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 3...」

647:t_005:3.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 10...」

647:t_005:4.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 17...」

647:t_005:5.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 22...」

647:t_005:6.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 29...」

647:t_005:7.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 36...」

647:t_005:8.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans with wicked minds. So you have finally ventured out into the galactic sea.」

647:t_005:9.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Our mission is the elimination of wicked humanity.」

647:t_005:10.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「We will carry out that mission.」

647:t_005:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! Why do you get to decide on your own that the people of Earth have wicked minds!?」

647:t_005:12.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「It is not a presumption. We have always observed the planet called Earth, in every world.」

647:t_005:13.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「It is a span of time so vast that you could not imagine it.」

647:t_005:14.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「And we reached a conclusion. Earthlings are wicked beings.」

647:t_005:15.en:
$$葵$$
「One-sided logic, shutting down any rebuttal, totally groundless assumptions... Typical of a machine that's all theory.」

647:t_005:16.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「You cannot understand our words... That cannot be helped.」

647:t_005:17.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「But we will not permit your advance into the galaxy... your evolution.」

647:t_005:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Quit talking like the $$御使い$$s, you clay-figure punk!」

647:t_005:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「I won't be fooled by your words anymore! I fight to protect Earth... and everyone!」

647:t_005:20.en:
$$勝平$$
「You guys only look at the bad in people and refuse to acknowledge the good. You're the ones who should vanish from this universe!」

647:t_005:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「We're going to live! And if there's anyone who won't allow that, I'll fight them with everything I've got!」

647:t_006:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$! You came for us!」

647:t_006:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I have waited for this day, my little brothers! You have at last walked the path of evolution and stepped into $$シンカ$$!」

647:t_006:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now is the time to fight together! The life of $$ゼウス$$ is with you!」

647:t_006:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... It's weird. You're saying the same kind of thing as that $$ミケーネ$$ guy, but it hits me right in the gut.」

647:t_006:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course it does! Uncle $$ゼウス$$ has been on our side since way back!」

647:t_006:6.en:
$$號$$
「The one who never spoiled us, always encouraged us, and showed us the way...」

647:t_006:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「I get it now, $$ゼウス$$. You were trying to fulfill the mission of a higher-dimensional life form.」

647:t_006:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「But you overcame that trial, arrogant as it was, and have stepped out into the galaxy like this!」

647:t_006:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now let me praise your power, your spirit! And your growth!」

647:t_006:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you very much, $$ゼウス$$!」

647:t_006:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But it's too early to be praising us.」

647:t_006:13.en:
$$赤木$$
「Because from here on, we're going to get past the villains blocking our way!」

647:t_006:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ガイゾック$$! Since you all showed up together, that's convenient! I'll settle things with you here!」

uncertain: 647:t_002:16 (Hayato): Mycenae talked about in third person (they) to match Benkei's line; could be addressed to the Mycenaeans (you).
647:t_003:2: hostile Mycenaean: Spheres rendered passively (cannot let ... be handed to the Angels); who would hand them over is unspecified in Japanese.
647:t_003:1: Gura's 'Father' is separate from Xul; identity not verified.
647:t_005:2-7: Computer Doll numbers as $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. N.
647:t_006:3: 'The life of Zeus is with you' is deliberately literal (self-referring 'this Zeus').
647:t_005:15: 頭でっかち rendered 'a machine that's all theory'.
